Welcome to La Petite Academy, located in Avon, IN! Our school at 125 N County Road 800 E. serves families looking for trusted daycare and preschool in the [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: neighborhood or locality name] area, between [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Landmark 1] and [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Landmark 2]. Our school includes care for Infants through School-Age and offers an On My Way Pre-K Program year-round. La Petite Academy Avon is nationally accredited by National Early Childhood Program Accreditation and is Level 4 Paths to Quality Rating.

Families choose our school for its outdoor playtime, which gives children room to explore, build confidence, and feel comfortable from their first day. Led by [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Director name], our team is committed to building strong relationships with children and families. The majority of our teachers either hold degrees in early childhood education or a related field or are working toward a degree. Many educators have been part of our school community for [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: years of staff tenure], helping children develop trusted relationships with familiar teachers.

Serving families in Avon, IN for [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: years serving the community], La Petite Academy provides early education and childcare focused on supporting children's social, emotional, and academic development. We offer a safe, nurturing environment where children can learn, grow, and thrive every day. Our approach helps children build the confidence and skills needed for a successful transition to kindergarten. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. Explore our Programs section to learn more about La Petite Academy of Avon, IN. Give us a call today to schedule a tour, we cannot wait to meet you and your family!
